title: Integers: Ordering, Comparing, Adding and Subtracting
seo_title: Grade 7 Integers Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Count forwards and backwards in integers; order and compare integers; add and subtract integers; recognise and use commutative and associative properties of addition for integers; recognise and use additive inverses.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 integers worksheets: ordering and comparing integers, the number line, adding and subtracting integers and problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Right is bigger on the number line.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Integers are whole numbers and their opposites: … −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3 …
  • On a number line, numbers get bigger to the right: −3 > −8.
  • Adding a negative number moves left: 5 + (−8) = −3.
  • Subtracting a negative number is the same as adding: 4 − (−6) = 4 + 6 = 10.

Examples

Example

−7 − (−12)

−7 + 12

Answer: 5

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
−8 > −3−8 is further left, so it is smaller.
The wrong wayAdding a negative moves left.
− (−)Subtracting a negative means add.

items.q: A freezer is set to −18 °C and a fridge is set to 4 °C. What is the difference between the two temperatures?
items.e: 4 − (−18) = 4 + 18 = 22 degrees. Subtracting a negative means adding its opposite.

items.q: Zanele is scuba diving in Howe Sound at −12 m. She swims up 5 m. What is her new position?
items.e: Up means adding: −12 + 5 = −7 m. She is still below sea level.

items.q: Fatima is diving at −6 m and Karabo is diving at −14 m. How far apart are they?
items.e: Subtract the positions: −6 − (−14) = −6 + 14 = 8 m. Both are below sea level, so the distance is 14 − 6.

items.q: A robot submarine is exploring the ocean off Haida Gwaii at −85 m. It rises 35 m. What is its new position?
items.e: Rising means adding: −85 + 35 = −50 m.

items.q: Daniel’s bank balance is −R30. He deposits R50 of birthday money. What is the balance now?
items.e: A deposit means adding: −30 + 50 = R20.

items.q: In a class trivia game, a right answer is +10 points and a wrong answer is −15 points. A team has −20 points and then gets one wrong answer. What is the team’s score now?
items.e: A wrong answer adds −15: −20 + (−15) = −35.
